thread:
jordan: FYI customer FinArc asking for a 4-week POC. Need alignment on success criteria + rough capacity/cost so we can lock the SOW. They want low-latency chat and embeddings for 500k monthly queries.

anita: quick background — FinArc target is realtime advisor in their dashboard. SLA = <300ms 95p for single-turn chat, and embedding lookups need to handle 250 qps peak. Budget demo-stage ~= $8k-$15k.

sam: couple clarifying q's: 1) avg prompt+response tokens per chat? 2) embedding size & index QPS? 3) eval set for quality pass/fail?

jordan: they said ~220 tokens in + ~400 tokens out average for chat. Embedding = 1536 dim, ~5k items in index for POC, cold QPS ~100, peak 250. Eval = 200 chat prompts + NPS survey.

sam: OK. rough throughput calc: for chat at avg 620 tokens/req -> ~620 * 250 = 155k tokens/s at peak. With Redwood-1-large baseline perf on A100 ~ 50k tokens/s per GPU (depends on quant). So estimate 3 GPUs for peak headroom. This is continuous bursty traffic not sustained 24/7.

maya: re infra: for latency <300ms 95p we need small batch sizes and reserved capacity. Suggest config: 3x A100 (or 4x T4s as lower-cost option but higher p95). Enable KV prefix cache for repeated context.

infra-bot: automated-estimate: model=redwood-1-large, quant=qa8_ggml -> est tokens/sec/GPU=52k, peak gpus_needed=ceil(155000/52000)=3, est monthly tokens for POC (4 weeks) assuming avg 6 hours/day peak: 155k * 60 * 60 * 6 * 28 = 941,184,000 tokens.

anita: cost framing for finance: hosted usage + reserved burst. If using Dedicated A100 monthly list ~ $8k/GPU (ballpark incl infra) -> 3 GPUs * $8k * (4/4) = $24k. But for a limited POC we can offer lower committed price or spot-backed to hit ~ $10-12k.

sam: alternative hybrid approach: host chat on a smaller quantized variant (redwood-1-medium-qa8) for most traffic and route heavy-long responses to large model. Split routing reduces GPU needs to ~2 large + 1 medium. Also use token caps and truncation in prompt templates to reduce avg tokens.

jordan: security ask — FinArc requires SOC2 checklist + answers to KMS + data retention. They also want network diagram and confirmation that we can run in their VPC for Private POC.

maya: we can do Private POC in customer VPC; will need ECDH keys and KMS integration. For the short POC we can use customer-managed KMS; need 1 week to provision. Add to timeline.

anita: proposed timeline: Week 0 — SOW sign, KMS + VPC setup (1 week), Week 1 — model infra + ingest eval data (1 week), Week 2 — run evals & tuning, Week 3 — customer trial & collect metrics, Week 4 — wrap-up + decision.

sam: success criteria (we should get on same page): 1) p95 latency <300ms for single-turn chat during 90% of test windows, 2) embedding recall @k=10 >= baseline (they'll share golden set), 3) throughput 200-250 qps with no errors, 4) quality pass on 200 eval prompts.

jordan: can we put numbers in the SOW: target tokens/month for POC, reserved GPUs, and a fail/accept clause tied to the eval set?

anita: yes — I'll draft SOW: target 1B tokens cap for 4 weeks, reserve 3 A100 equiv, optional fallback to quantized medium. Acceptance = meets 3/4 success criteria incl quality & latency.

maya: blocker: require customer to provide sample traffic patterns and allow load tests (we need a 2-hr blast to validate autoscale). If they decline perf testing we can't guarantee SLA.

jordan: I'll ask them to confirm load test window and share security contacts. Anything else?

sam: just add prompt templates and truncation guidance to the onboarding docs. Also we'll include cost-reduction knobs: caching, dynamic routing, smaller model for embeddings.

anita: perfect. I'll update the SOW draft and ping legal + security for the questionnaire. Jordan, looping you in with the timeline email. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — I'll follow up with FinArc today and push for the test window. :rocket:
